title: Synthetic future-unsupported fixture
body: This payload declares payload_schema_version 999999, which this build's RecordPayload::from_json must never claim to understand -- 999999 is chosen to remain newer than any real version this codebase reaches, not tied to today's current value (src/project.rs::RECORD_PAYLOAD_SCHEMA_VERSION), so this fixture keeps proving the same thing across future schema-version bumps without needing to be regenerated.
hypothetical_future_field: a real future payload_schema_version 2 could add real fields here; this fixture invents none as a production format, it only proves refusal
